failure: PID-existence observer returned false for process_stopped after owned-tree cancellation
diagnosis: The original POSIX test equated an existing PID with a running process and did not wait for asynchronous signal delivery or distinguish a zombie. Exact transient process state was not captured in the original run.
correction: Bounded POSIX state observation treats only a missing PID or zombie as exited, and adds a live-process versus unreaped-exit regression. Product cancellation implementation remains unchanged.
